acceptance_criteria: Net daily edge after the 0.10% round-trip taker cost is positive
spec.alternative_hypothesis: Lagged BTC daily returns explain a positive, out-of-sample component of next-day ETH returns beyond ETH's own lagged return and the SOL common-factor control.
spec.benchmark: ETH own-history baseline: next-day ETH return predicted from its own lagged return and the SOL common factor only
cost_assumptions: OKX VIP0 taker fee 0.05% per side, from the OKX public fee schedule (okx.com/fees), checked 2026-11-18; treated as an assumption, not verified for the user's account
Funding rate costs ignored; perpetual funding can exceed taker fees over holding periods
Slippage and market impact ignored; both would reduce any edge
spec.cost_model: Round-trip taker cost 0.10% per position flip (OKX VIP0 taker 0.05% per side, assumed); sign rule on out-of-sample augmented forecasts, 1x, always invested; funding, slippage and market impact ignored
exclusions: Unconfirmed (forming) bars are excluded; only confirm=1 candles enter the panel
Bars after the preregistered window end 2026-11-18T16:00Z are out of sample
known_confounders: SOL common-factor proxy is itself driven by BTC and may absorb part of the transmission effect; the no-factor result is reported as an upper-bound control
Common crypto market shocks move BTC, ETH and SOL together; the partial lead-lag controls for contemporaneous SOL returns only
Daily bars are anchored at 16:00 UTC (midnight UTC+8); the lag-1 effect is defined on that grid
spec.mechanism: BTC is the largest and most liquid crypto perpetual market; information and liquidity shocks may reprice BTC first and transmit to ETH with a lag, so yesterday's BTC return predicts today's ETH return beyond ETH's own autocorrelation.
spec.missing_data_policy: No forward filling; drop incomplete synchronized rows and report the dropped count
model_definition: Partial lead-lag OLS with HAC standard errors
1H BTC→ETH partial lead-lag as a predeclared robustness check
spec.multiple_testing_family: BTC/ETH/SOL perpetual cross-market transmission, daily and 1H (3 tests: daily BTC→ETH, daily BTC→SOL, 1H BTC→ETH)
spec.null_hypothesis: Lagged BTC daily returns have no incremental predictive value for next-day ETH returns over ETH's own history and the common-factor control, after costs and dependence controls.
spec.primary_metric: Partial R-squared of lag-1 BTC return in the daily BTC→ETH partial lead-lag regression
rejection_criteria: Holm-adjusted primary p-value at or above 0.05
Holdout out-of-sample incremental R-squared at or below 0
Net daily edge after costs is zero or negative
spec.research_question: Do daily BTC-USDT perpetual returns at lag 1 contain incremental information about next-day ETH-USDT perpetual returns beyond ETH's own history and a common-factor control?
spec.target_definition: Next-day close-to-close ETH-USDT perpetual log return
spec.title: BTC perpetual returns lead ETH perpetual returns
